provenance.license: MIT (WrightKit-authored data, ownership transfer to workshop-rs per wright#136 direction; see docs/provenance.md)
provenance.source: en-US spellings transcribed from the compatibility corpus workshop snapshots and the M5 support matrix; squareRoot spelling from the Workshop emission surface for .opy sqrt(); receiver-call action/value spellings (setMoveSpeed, isAlive, getPosition, getHealth, teleport, setMaxHealth, setHealth, setAimSpeed, setGravity, setDamageDealt, setDamageReceived, setUltCharge) from the pinned en-US emission surface for .opy eventPlayer.<method>(...) forms, evidenced by the synthetic/receiver-calls corpus fixture (#104); ChaseTimeReeval and ChaseRateReeval member spellings (None, Destination and Duration, Destination and Rate) reference-validated against the pinned enum blocks and emission (#105); chaseOverTime (Chase Global Variable Over Time), isGameInProgress (Is Game In Progress), getPlayersInRadius (Players Within Radius), worldVector (World Vector Of), getThrottle (Throttle Of), setInvisibility (Set Invisible) with the Invis domain, setStatusEffect (Set Status) with the Status domain, the Transform domain, and the LosCheck domain transcribed from the en-US emission surface for the OPY semantic manifest probes (#109); chaseAtRate (Chase Global Variable At Rate), chasePlayerVariableAtRate (Chase Player Variable At Rate), and chasePlayerVariableOverTime (Chase Player Variable Over Time) transcribed from the en-US emission surface for the chase keyword-argument probes (#110); OSTW exercised builtin params/spellings and enum domain/member data transcribed from pinned reference probe emissions and the protect-ban entry-point reachable closure (#118); rule-event identities and EventTeam/EventPlayer filter aliases are transcribed from the user-provided workshop-data export and its Workshop event annotations, cross-checked against documented raw Workshop event forms; migrated to workshop-rs from the Wright-authored catalog on 2026-08-16 as the canonical Workshop catalog; the chase-family expected enum domains migrate the Wright-authored semantic manifest probe data (#109/#110) into the canonical catalog so the standalone core resolves the shared bare None member without any Wright tooling dependency; zh-CN aliases are generated from the user-provided workshop-data JSON; confirmed identity/GUID mappings cover global stop-chasing, force hero/throttle, Set Player Allowed Heroes, the four bare comparison symbols, and three enum aliases; legacy/provider syntax sugar is intentionally outside the declared catalog surface; the exact-match corpus and its exclusions are pinned separately in tools/corpus/zh-cn-corpus.json
sourceNotes: abort zh-CN retains both 中止 from the reviewed workshop-data export and 中断 observed in the reproducible Bastion c010e1a2d468ec7140f474e334067e5ab8d02d89 build:release/build:main:zh output; the first spelling is emitted deterministically and both are accepted for parsing

disableBuiltinGameModeCompletion zh-CN retains 禁用内置游戏模式完成 from the reviewed workshop-data export and 关闭游戏预设完成条件 observed in the same reproducible Bastion build; the first spelling is emitted deterministically and both are accepted for parsing

value and enum identities added in the Bastion spatial/player/effect slice are cross-checked against workshop-data GUID translations and the reproducible c010e1a2d468ec7140f474e334067e5ab8d02d89 en-US/zh-CN builds; aliases remain data-backed and canonical signatures retain their declared parameter domains

Is Dummy Bot, Ability Cooldown, facing-angle/speed, ground-state, dot-product, event-damage, normalize, and angle-difference values are transcribed from the pinned workshop-data export and exercised by the pinned direct raw Workshop artifacts
event/control/effect identities added in this slice are transcribed from workshop-data constants and values and exercised by the pinned direct raw Workshop artifacts

93 additional value identities are mechanically reconciled from the pinned workshop-data export d854bf01fc7bbf3b2169f67408c07a8da8989ad6; parameter names/types and reviewed en-US/zh-CN aliases remain data-backed
enum domains/members and action signatures are reconciled from the pinned workshop-data export d854bf01fc7bbf3b2169f67408c07a8da8989ad6; structural aliases remain owned by the parser

parameter and Value return types for 361 exact-id entries are reconciled from the pinned OverPy static metadata at https://github.com/Zezombye/overpy/tree/d854bf01fc7bbf3b2169f67408c07a8da8989ad6, whose metadata credits the parsed Workshop documentation at https://github.com/arxenix/owws-documentation/blob/master/workshop.json; unmatched or arity-conflicting entries remain evidence-insufficient instead of being inferred

Workshop.codes structured wiki articles are a direct documentation cross-check for the declared Action/Value properties, including Returns, Parameters, parameter Type, and Default (for example https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/add, https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/teleport, and https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/set-crouch-enabled); entries absent from the reviewed evidence or with source conflicts remain evidence-insufficient instead of being inferred
Representative Workshop.codes article links are retained as a source cross-check; fetched snapshots and acceptance results are CI evidence, not generator or runtime inputs
OverPy metadata is a static cross-check only; it is not treated as a runtime or .NET dependency

OSTW static Elements.json at https://github.com/ItsDeltin/Overwatch-Script-To-Workshop/tree/817c1db4bace52123f054ffe10d3d8a06052e687 provides an independent cross-check: 210 Action and 250 Value names match the current en-US catalog; its any/any[] declarations keep polymorphic entries evidence-insufficient rather than narrowing them

static type spellings Clip/GamemodeLiteral/HeroLiteral are normalized to the canonical Clipping/Gamemode/Hero enum domains; distance, directionTowards, vector, vectorTowards, getObjectivePosition, charAt, valueInArray, arrayContains, max, and min retain Any parameter contracts where the pinned real-project artifacts demonstrate Workshop polymorphism beyond a narrower static declaration

current vector constants, Game Mode and Modulo values, Gamemode members, Hero and Color domain aliases, and To Nearest alias are reconciled from workshop-data export d854bf01fc7bbf3b2169f67408c07a8da8989ad6
